name: Mistral Large 4

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; the Hugging Face repo was created 2026-09-30

params.note: derived from config (weights ship in FP8, so the Hub gives no plain count); card: about 1T total, 49B active per token, 52B with embeddings and output layer

position.nope_layers: every 4th layer (0-based 3, 7, ... 71): 18 NoPE layers, 54 RoPE layers

moe.router: softmax over 128, keep top-4, renormalise; one expert group

stack.note: all 72 layers: MLA with DSA top-2048. Layer 0 has a dense FFN, 1-71 MoE. Layers 39, 43, ... 71 reuse layer 35's latent KV (kv_source_layers). Layers 17-18, 21-22, ... 69-70 (indexer_types 'shared') run no indexer and reuse the top-k of the layer before them, so each group of three layers shares one indexer

steps.label: no query LoRA; latent KV 512 (+64 RoPE dims, none on NoPE layers); SSMax query scaling; DSA keeps the top 2048 keys
1 shared + top-4 of 128 SwiGLU experts, width 6144 (layer 0: dense SwiGLU 24576)

specials.name: sparse_topk
specials.what: DSA indexer (32 heads x 128) keeps the top 2048 keys; in 28 layers (0-based 17-18, 21-22, ... 69-70) no indexer runs and the layer reuses the top-k of the full-indexer layer before it, so groups of three layers share one
specials.where: every layer; one indexer is shared by the paired former-SWA layers from layer 17

specials.name: kv_sharing
specials.what: YOCO kept from the original design: global (NoPE) layers in the second half reuse layer 35's latent KV and only own their kv_b expansion

specials.name: lerope
specials.what: LeRoPE: a learned per-frequency factor exp(alpha) scales the YaRN rotary frequencies

specials.name: log_length_scaling
specials.what: SSMax: per-head learned scale s*log(position+1)+b multiplies the queries

specials.name: nope
specials.what: one layer in four has no rotary dims (the original global layers)

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: DSpark speculative-decoding draft head (3 MLA layers, reads target layers 1, 18, 36, 54, 71)
specials.where: after the main stack; inference only

omitted_towers.what: Pixtral-style ViT trained from scratch, 14x14 patches, 2x2 patch merger

params.note: Mistral-native config: head_dim 128, nope 'rope,rope,rope,nope', lerope, ssmax_scaling, dsa, kv_sharing, mtp

readme.note: 'Key Features': ~1T total, 49B active (52B incl. embeddings), 128 experts top-4 + 1 shared, 1M context, licence

notes: config.json head_dim is 64 and is the rotary width (qk_rope_head_dim); params.json head_dim 128 is the full query/key head. The record uses 128.
Config num_key_value_heads 64 is nominal: MLA caches one 512-wide latent plus 64 RoPE dims per token.
Raschka's gallery summarises the attention as 'three LeRoPE layers with one NoPE layer'; config, params.json and code agree.
The report says one in four layers was full attention and the rest SWA (window 512) before surgery; the released model has no window.
Training history: pretrained as 3 sliding-window (512) layers per global layer with CLA and YOCO KV sharing; surgery before phase 2 removed the windows and CLA, kept YOCO.

rope.note: q/k head 64 nope + 64 rope; YaRN factor 2048 over 512; LeRoPE; layer 0 has a dense FFN
